title: FlashPrefill V2: Block-Sparse Prefill Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.19758v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context modeling is a pivotal capability for Large Language Models, yet the quadratic complexity of attention remains a critical bottleneck, particularly during the compute-intensive prefilling phase. Our previous work, FlashPrefill, mitigates this cost through instantaneous pattern discovery and max-based dynamic thresholding; however, it remains an algorithmic prototype that is still distant from production deployment. In this paper, we present FlashPrefill V2, which evolves FlashPrefill from a prototype toward practical long-context serving along three dimensions. translated_title: FlashPrefill V2：面向长上下文LLM服务的块稀疏预填充注意力机制
translated_abstract: 长上下文建模是大语言模型的关键能力，但注意力的二次方复杂度仍是关键瓶颈，尤其是在计算密集的预填充阶段。我们之前的工作FlashPrefill通过即时模式发现和基于最大值的动态阈值化来缓解这一成本；然而，它仍是一个算法原型，距离生产部署尚远。在本文中，我们提出FlashPrefill V2，它从三个维度将FlashPrefill从原型演进为实用的长上下文服务。首先，我们引入均值修正项，有效抑制近似误差，即使在极端稀疏度下也能保持性能退化可控。其次，我们重新设计了稀疏注意力算子，采用PackGQA内存访问、warp专用化和乒乓流水线，完全对齐最新的FlashAttention-3/4实现，并支持多种精度格式。最后，我们优化了工作负载调度，以实现高效的动态稀疏模式管理，确保在推理期间实现高吞吐量。在多种长上下文基准测试上的实验表明，FlashPrefill V2在保持高模型质量的同时，实现了显著优于现有方法的加速。
tldr: FlashPrefill V2通过均值修正项和优化的稀疏注意力算子，将稀疏预填充从原型推向生产部署，在极端稀疏下保持低误差并显著加速长上下文服务。
en_tdlr: FlashPrefill V2 advances sparse prefill from prototype to production by introducing a mean correction term and optimized sparse attention operators, achieving high speedup while maintaining model quality in long-context serving.
